Class BehaviorKeys

java.lang.Object
com.trevlar.menukit.api.window.BehaviorKeys
public final class BehaviorKeys extends Object
The library's built-in BehaviorKeys, one constant per behaviour. The engine is generic, so a mod adds a behaviour by declaring a key of its own.
  • Client tier: VISIBILITY, OPACITY, and the observed reactions.
  • Server tier, the slot author's rules: GATING (what a slot accepts and releases, and how many), BINDING (Curse of Binding on any slot), and the eleven operations. Containers keeps ContainerKeys.MENDING, whose seam (the XP orb) is its own.

  • Field Details

    • VISIBILITY

      public static final BehaviorKey<VisibilityRule> VISIBILITY
      Whether an addressable thing is shown, a client-side VisibilityRule predicate (re-evaluated each frame), so one key spans static hide and dynamic reveal (hover). Client-tier, every kind. Default VisibilityRule.VISIBLE. Resolved + evaluated on the client only (never server-side; see VisibilityRule).

    • OPACITY

      public static final BehaviorKey<TriBool> OPACITY
      Whether a panel is interaction-opaque (eats clicks over its bounds). Client- tier, panels only. Default TriBool.TRUE (M9: panels opaque by default).

    • GATING

      public static final BehaviorKey<SlotGate> GATING
      What a slot accepts and releases, and its per-item stack cap: a SlotGate. Default SlotGate.OPEN, exactly vanilla. MenuKit enforces it once at each vanilla method that moves items (§0064).

    • BINDING

      public static final BehaviorKey<TriBool> BINDING
      Whether Curse of Binding is enforced on this slot: a bound item cannot be taken out while the player is alive, survival only, the rule vanilla gives armour slots. Default TriBool.FALSE.

    • ON_INSERT_OBSERVED

      public static final BehaviorKey<ReactiveHook> ON_INSERT_OBSERVED
      Fires on the client when synced slot contents grow, pure UI feedback (flash, sound, badge), no authority. CLIENT tier → MK-alone capable, and fires for created slots too (their contents sync identically). Default ReactiveHook.NONE.

    • ON_TAKE_OBSERVED

      public static final BehaviorKey<ReactiveHook> ON_TAKE_OBSERVED
      Fires on the client when synced slot contents shrink, pure UI feedback, no authority. CLIENT tier; default ReactiveHook.NONE.

    • COLLECT

      public static final BehaviorKey<TriBool> COLLECT
      Operation: whether vanilla's double-click collect may take from this slot (canTakeItemForPickAll). Default TriBool.TRUE: vanilla sweeps it.

    • DRAG_FILL

      public static final BehaviorKey<TriBool> DRAG_FILL
      Operation: whether vanilla's drag-fill (spreading a carried stack across slots) may place into this slot (canDragTo). Default TriBool.TRUE.

    • CLICK_TAKE

      public static final BehaviorKey<TriBool> CLICK_TAKE
      Operation: whether a plain click may pick up this slot's items. A click that swaps the cursor's items for different ones in the slot takes and puts, so it needs this and CLICK_PUT.

    • CLICK_PUT

      public static final BehaviorKey<TriBool> CLICK_PUT
      Operation: whether a plain click may put the cursor's items into this slot, all or one.

    • SHIFT_CLICK_OUT

      public static final BehaviorKey<TriBool> SHIFT_CLICK_OUT
      Operation: whether shift-clicking this slot may send its stack elsewhere.

    • SHIFT_CLICK_IN

      public static final BehaviorKey<TriBool> SHIFT_CLICK_IN
      Operation: whether a shift-click elsewhere may land items in this slot.

    • HOTBAR_SWAP

      public static final BehaviorKey<TriBool> HOTBAR_SWAP
      Operation: whether a number key may swap this slot with a hotbar slot. Both slots of a swap must allow it.

    • OFFHAND_SWAP

      public static final BehaviorKey<TriBool> OFFHAND_SWAP
      Operation: whether the offhand key may swap this slot with the offhand. Both slots must allow it.

    • DROP

      public static final BehaviorKey<TriBool> DROP
      Operation: whether Q may drop one item out of this slot.

    • DROP_STACK

      public static final BehaviorKey<TriBool> DROP_STACK
      Operation: whether Ctrl-Q may drop this slot's whole stack.

    • INVENTORY_INSERT

      public static final BehaviorKey<TriBool> INVENTORY_INSERT
      Operation: whether an item given to the inventory may land in this slot, including topping up a partial stack already there. Every insertion through Inventory.getFreeSlot and getSlotWithRemainingSpace: a pickup from the ground, /give, creative pick-block, a crafting grid's returns, recipe placement. The id stays menukit:world_pickup, since consumers persist ids. Off-menu seam: resolves from the slot's own declaration or the default, then the vetoes.

    • VANILLA_OPERATIONS

      public static final List<BehaviorKey<TriBool>> VANILLA_OPERATIONS
      Every operation vanilla ships, in the order a settings list would show them.
